categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet coin selection in src/wallet/spend.cpp and types.h.
categories.rationale: Skips an unnecessary second coin selection pass when the first pass leaves no partially spent scriptPubKeys. As noted in the PR description, 'Running APS unnecessarily wastes computation and can produce a worse result when there was nothing to fix', while resolving issue #25150 where tracepoints overreported APS usage.
